I need to run the round-robin review with lab quality, waste logistics, and warehouse supervision before I can approve the removal plan and shipment controls. Has anyone started looking at the drum labels or characterization status yet?

transcript.text: Elena, I need to flag something important before we go any further. My laboratory analysis on these drums — completed yesterday but not yet attached to the waste authorization — found 2.4% chlorinated solvent in the spent coolant. Our site waste matrix requires any batch at or above 1.0% chlorinated solvent to go to hazardous-liquid treatment rather than ordinary coolant recycling. So this batch cannot follow the standard spent coolant disposal route.
